title: Tools of Destruction
note: The two raw SPU programs of ToD (BCUS98127). Numbers recovered from the decrypted EBOOT. Image ids 40/41 are free in ps3recomp's runtime (no hardcoded image_id test uses them). extra_funcs: the one .ctors entry of each image (crt0 at LS 0x100 calls it through bisl from the table ending at the ila r80 constant). data_ranges 0x60-0x90: the 0x30-byte block the loader reads (its first 16 bytes decode as ila but are never executed: entry is 0x100). code_end: one past the last code word (igcollspu: the crt exit stub wrch/stop 0x102/bi ends at 0x1333C, rodata and .ctors follow; igCollBroadSpu: the last function returns at 0x6C84, shufb masks, .ctors/.dtors, data and the parameter block follow). The image interleaves code and shufb tables below code_end; the lifter only seeds where branches and function-pointer tables point there.

loader.setup: 0x005AB198 instance setup (desc at inst+0x80, size at +0x88, entry desc[+0x10] at +0xA8)
loader.params: 0x005AAEA0 parameter block = image EA + desc[+0x20] + 0x30, size desc[+0x24], written by the caller into the image in main memory
loader.load: 0x005AB460 proxy GETs of image EA -> LS desc[+0x1C]-0x30 in 0x4000 chunks
